title: 2024 Hualien earthquake
summary: A Mw 7.4 earthquake struck off the east coast of Taiwan on 3 April 2024, with the strongest shaking in Hualien County. Reports give 18 deaths, three missing and over 1,100 injured. Damage was comparatively low, which a reconnaissance team credited to seismic resilience gains since the 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake.

uncertainty.note: Local time 07:58 on 3 April 2024 (UTC+8) per UCL; magnitude differs by agency (local 7.2 vs Mw 7.4).

where.historical_name: Offshore Hualien County, Taiwan (Republic of China)

importance.justification: Strongest Taiwan earthquake in decades, with 18 deaths and widespread disruption, but limited damage relative to size.
